hero.title: Welcome to your AI agent setup
hero.body_markdown: Your setup session turns your workflows, tools, and recurring tasks into a concrete agent build plan. The portal copy uses the central welcome template and marks unsourced variants as needing approval.

welcome_templates.subject: Your OpenClaw Agent Setup Session - What to Expect
welcome_templates.body_markdown:
Hi {client_name},

Welcome. We're excited to build your personal AI agent. Your 90-minute setup session is confirmed for {session_date} at {session_time} {timezone}.

Before the call, complete the prep guide so we can start with your goals, tools, workflows, and preferences. After the call, GBAutomation builds and deploys the agent system within {delivery_window}.

If you have questions before the call, reply by email or message {support_channel}.

welcome_templates.subject: Your AI Agent Setup Session - What to Expect
welcome_templates.body_markdown: This runtime-neutral variant is safe for portal preview, but it needs human approval because the canonical source currently names OpenClaw while newer runtime policy defaults to Hermes.

proof.notes: Resolve Hermes vs OpenClaw vs runtime-neutral naming before sending.

before_call_checklist.label: List daily apps and tools
before_call_checklist.description: Include whether each tool has an API or export path.

before_call_checklist.label: Name the 3 to 5 areas of your work
before_call_checklist.description: These become the first map for agent departments and skills.

before_call_checklist.label: Pick the most annoying recurring task
before_call_checklist.description: Bring one concrete task that repeats often and drains attention.

steps.title: Start with context
steps.body_markdown: GBAutomation reviews prospect and personal context before the first workflow decisions are made.

steps.title: Create the engagement workspace
steps.body_markdown: A Drive folder and starter documents establish the working surface for the engagement.

steps.title: Hold discovery and intake
steps.body_markdown: Discovery aligns scope. Intake captures goals, tools, workflows, and preferences for the build team.

steps.title: Build and deploy the agent
steps.body_markdown: The transcript is converted into workspace materials, expert systems, repository setup, and deployment tasks.

steps.title: Register support and monitoring
steps.body_markdown: The engagement is registered in client logs, async channels, and monitoring routines so follow-up work is visible.

requirements_checklists.label: Client second-brain workspace exists
requirements_checklists.description: The engagement needs a client workspace with canonical context, contacts, intelligence, tasks, and knowledge areas.

requirements_checklists.label: Client repository follows gbauto/{client-slug}
requirements_checklists.description: Top-level client repositories are the expected placement for client builds.

requirements_checklists.label: External meeting attendee mapping is captured
requirements_checklists.description: Calendar prep depends on mapping external attendee addresses to a client slug. Email values are not rendered here.

proof.notes: Personal email mappings are intentionally not included in the portal artifact.

integration_requirements.label: Google Workspace access path
integration_requirements.description: The central requirements baseline includes Google Workspace for Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, and Sheets workflows.

integration_requirements.label: GitHub repository access
integration_requirements.description: Client work expects a repository under the top-level gbauto client slug convention.

missing_inputs.label: Client-specific proof source
missing_inputs.description: No canonical client-specific proof index was found for sales or delivery claims.

admin_checklists.label: Create Drive folder and starter docs
admin_checklists.description: Admin setup includes a welcome email and starter documents before discovery and intake.

admin_checklists.label: Deploy agent runtime
admin_checklists.description: Deployment target is selected by the engagement; internal host and port details are intentionally excluded.

proof.notes: Internal host, account, and secret details are omitted.

admin_checklists.label: Start monitoring and client logs
admin_checklists.description: Daily client logs and inbox monitoring are the source-backed operational follow-up paths.

pillars.title: Every run is logged
pillars.body_markdown: Agent execution is designed to leave auditable records instead of black-box claims.

pillars.title: Tracing and telemetry are built in
pillars.body_markdown: The source sales material presents end-to-end tracing, token spend, latency, and error visibility as a production guardrail.

pillars.title: Plan before build, review before merge
pillars.body_markdown: The pipeline keeps human approval at plan and merge checkpoints.

pillars.title: Silent failures get caught
pillars.body_markdown: The sales source explicitly calls out output scanning for failure markers even when exit codes are clean.

build_flow_steps.title: PRD approved
build_flow_steps.body_markdown: Work starts from an approved plan, not an improvised chat request.

build_flow_steps.title: Issue and routing
build_flow_steps.body_markdown: The build is routed through the right workflow and agent team.

build_flow_steps.title: Verify before shipping
build_flow_steps.body_markdown: Telemetry, silent-failure checks, disk verification, pull request review, and human approval are the final gates.
